83067b19-bdfb-4ba1-8178-7052e68b41bf.altTitle: Different World Survival to Go with the Master!
83067b19-bdfb-4ba1-8178-7052e68b41bf.description:
Kosuke found himself in a whole different world. Standing there with the wilderness to the east and a forest to his left, he decided to make good use of the occurrence, and tests his knowledge, to where he finds this amazing crafting ability, just like the games from his original world! ――This is a light for life in a different world. When I thought, I was suddenly attacked by a beautiful dark elf...!?

6b06fe1e-ff99-4c8d-be0b-5ad2a4df7603.title: Kajiya de Hajimeru Isekai Slow Life
6b06fe1e-ff99-4c8d-be0b-5ad2a4df7603.altTitle: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World
6b06fe1e-ff99-4c8d-be0b-5ad2a4df7603.description:
One night, Eizo—a hapless corporate slave, saves a cat and gets hit by a truck. The cat which seems to be related to another world, in return for his help, grants Eizo a skill of his wish and reincarnates him to another world. Eizo, who has craftsmanship as a hobby and wishes to use this skill for a living, chooses to be reincarnated as a blacksmith. And so he starts his life in another world as a blacksmith just as he wishes. However, Eizo's creations are at another different level that will shake this new world.
___

b00ca6fd-4fab-4c8f-a981-4a89cefc5d89.title: The Villainess Is Retiring
b00ca6fd-4fab-4c8f-a981-4a89cefc5d89.altTitle: I'll Just Live on as a Villainess
b00ca6fd-4fab-4c8f-a981-4a89cefc5d89.description:
I reincarnated as the villainess in a book!  
The one who dared to commit attempted murder on the heroine is the owner of this body?  
  
Let’s just live in a quiet place where we have fun and eat! That’s what I thought for a while.  
It was so, so, so cold here in the north, where I was kicked out as a punishment.  
Before I froze to death, I called the Great Demon of Fire and set fire to the fireplace but…  
  
Why isn’t he going back? If you’ve done the job, shouldn’t you go back?!  
I was flustered to find out that I had signed a life contract with a demon just to start a fire but to think that I’d be responsible for relieving his desires!  
  
The bickering romance between a big puppy demon and a small villainess lady!  


---

837e01d6-f59b-4c2a-b9f7-68469215d0c6.altTitle: Handyman Saitou–san Goes To Another World
837e01d6-f59b-4c2a-b9f7-68469215d0c6.description: Handyman Saitou has never been anyone special. All his life, he's had average grades, ordinary athletic skill, a commonplace job... But his unremarkable path takes a turn when he wakes up in another world. Here, warriors, wizards, and elves accompany him on quests delving deep into dungeons, and Saitou realizes for the first time what it's like to be needed. After all, who other than the handyman could be trusted to open locked treasure chests or repair his allies' equipment?

18da0705-987a-470a-9037-faf25be21dc5.title: 8-Man
18da0705-987a-470a-9037-faf25be21dc5.description: The Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Investigation Division has 49 members, with 7 squads of 7 members. 8 Man, however, is part of an 8th squad, with no other members. In reality,  8 Man is a robot who assumes the identity of Azuma, a detective who works with the Metropolitan Police. 8 Man has abilities such as super speed, and the ability to shift his appearance. Only a select few know this secret - not even Ichiro or Sachiko, the two younger companions of Azuma, know this fact. 8 Man deals with all sorts of scoundrels and criminals from all over the world - both as the detective Azuma, and the robot 8 Man!

a7ca3cd9-88da-4dd6-9626-e12eae885f5d.title: Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes: Kyuuketsuki no Kizoku ni Tensei Shita kedo Suteraresou nanode Dungeon o Seiha Suru
a7ca3cd9-88da-4dd6-9626-e12eae885f5d.altTitle: Mercedes and the Waning Moon: The Dungeoneering Feats of a Discarded Vampire Aristocrat
a7ca3cd9-88da-4dd6-9626-e12eae885f5d.description:
Reborn as a vampire, Mercedes Grunewald has won the lottery of life. She's strong, quick, beautiful, and even a noble. Technically a noble, that is. Her mother is merely a concubine, and her father shows no interest in the family he's shunned to the countryside. Knowing the comforts of her life will be lost once he chooses an heir, she resolves to take matters into her own hands. At just ten years old, she begins a life of dungeon crawling. But what will she find for herself out there in the dungeons? In her past life, she died unfulfilled, but this time, she's set on achieving a different fate. Whether it be fame, fortune, or simply a reason to live, this time, her moon will be full.

*Source: J-Novel Club, Vol. 1*

00af0a04-1535-4f25-85b6-7d1b119dc48d.title: The Concours
00af0a04-1535-4f25-85b6-7d1b119dc48d.description: Ho-Kyung likes the violin, but born to a normal family, he has no intention of pursuing it as a career. When he was young, it was the small violin given to him by his friend Uiju that created the small passage connecting him to music. Now as a high school student, one accident destroys the precious violin and leads Ho-Kyung to an encounter with the violin repair workshop… A journey begins with a very simple wish, the desire to have his own violin.

c4507a61-13ae-4a43-b986-ca4d48967bac.description: In her childhood, Min Ju was naturally talented, receiving praise for her abilities. However, her confidence takes a hit when she meets young Han Seol. Feeling a twinge of jealousy and a sense of inferiority towards Han Seol's talent, Min Ju tries to keep her distance, but Han Seol continues to approach her...

d740f6d0-f39a-4cee-81b4-653bc6e9b698.title: Kyouiku Mama Saeko ─Kono Ko no Tame nara─

d740f6d0-f39a-4cee-81b4-653bc6e9b698.description:
Saeko is happy. Even if she is poor, even if she has no education, even if she is a single mother. As long as she has her only daughter, Yui. Beautiful Saeko dotes on her ugly daughter, who looks nothing like her, and today as well, she gathers happiness for her daughter by any means necessary.

2b22a9ca-7620-4826-aff4-c8c91129dc61.title: Idolatry
2b22a9ca-7620-4826-aff4-c8c91129dc61.description:
High school girl Junna Harumi's purpose in life is to support the idol Fuwari Tsukishiro!

One day, the idol group Fuwari belongs to disbands. In her despair, Junna learns that Fuwari will be trying out for an idol audition program. There will be a total of 100 participants - in order to lead her idol to the top, Junna decides to take part in the audition herself and work behind the scenes.

*Source: MangaUpdates, edited*
